evidence_sentence: The function first checks if the user-provided pointer is valid for reading.
rationale: The fixed implementation alone performs an upfront access_ok(VERIFY_READ, uregs, sizeof(elf_xtregs_t)) validation and returns -EFAULT when it fails. The vulnerable implementation has no such initial pointer-validity check; it proceeds directly to coprocessor handling and copy operations. The remaining Logic claims about flushing/releasing coprocessors when applicable, copying register values, and reporting copy failures are shared by both versions.
rewritten_docstring: The function flushes and releases coprocessors if applicable, then copies the extended register values from user space to the task's thread information and register structure. It returns an error code if any copy operation fails.
